summary: PAA priced a $1.5 billion junior subordinated note offering — $700 million 6.75% Series A and $800 million 7.00% Series B, both due 2056 — under an effective Form S-3, expected to close September 14, 2026. Net proceeds, with cash and commercial paper, fund redemption of all 58,411,908 Series A preferred units at 110% of $26.25 par ($28.875/unit) and all 800,000 Series B units at $1,000/unit par, plus accrued distributions, effective on or about September 14 and October 9, 2026. Watch execution risk and preferred cost of capital.
